verdict.rationale: Requesty documents service accounts as non-human identities whose keys are not tied to a user, which suits agents, and lets each API key or service account carry its own monthly spend cap. That is a real but narrow budget-based limit, not documented least-privilege scoping. Missing for 10: permission or endpoint scopes on keys, per-key model or provider allowlists, documented least-privilege key configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap.
spend from those keys will not be tied to any user.
